$comment: The theme knobs, for tools such as the website's theme builder. Source of wwwroot/stellar-admin.knobs.json; scripts/build-css.mjs checks it against tokens.css. Meanings follow docs/design/tokens.md.

knobs.name: --sa-accent
knobs.label: Accent
knobs.meaning: Brand colour: primary actions, focus, selection, bold highlights.

knobs.name: --sa-accent-dark
knobs.label: Accent (dark)
knobs.meaning: The accent in dark mode.

knobs.name: --sa-on-accent
knobs.label: Text on accent
knobs.meaning: Text on accent fills, instead of the automatic black or white.

knobs.name: --sa-danger
knobs.label: Danger
knobs.meaning: Destructive actions and errors.

knobs.name: --sa-danger-dark
knobs.label: Danger (dark)
knobs.meaning: The danger colour in dark mode.

knobs.name: --sa-success
knobs.label: Success
knobs.meaning: Status colour for success.

knobs.name: --sa-warning
knobs.label: Warning
knobs.meaning: Status colour for warnings.

knobs.name: --sa-info
knobs.label: Info
knobs.meaning: Status colour for information.

knobs.name: --sa-neutral-hue
knobs.label: Neutral hue
knobs.meaning: Hue the greys lean toward.

knobs.name: --sa-neutral-chroma
knobs.label: Neutral tint
knobs.meaning: How much the greys lean (0 is pure grey).

knobs.name: --sa-neutral-hue-dark
knobs.label: Neutral hue (dark)
knobs.meaning: The neutral hue in dark mode.

knobs.name: --sa-neutral-chroma-dark
knobs.label: Neutral tint (dark)
knobs.meaning: The neutral tint in dark mode.

knobs.name: --sa-accent-tint
knobs.label: Accent in washes
knobs.meaning: How much the accent tints hover, selection and highlight washes.

knobs.name: --sa-surface-depth
knobs.label: Surface depth
knobs.meaning: Separation between the page and cards (0 is one flat surface).

knobs.name: --sa-nav-tint
knobs.label: Sidebar tint
knobs.meaning: The sidebar, from page colour to sunken.

knobs.name: --sa-line-strength
knobs.label: Line strength
knobs.meaning: Dividers and control borders (below 0.75 acts as 0.75).

knobs.name: --sa-radius
knobs.label: Radius
knobs.meaning: Control corners.

knobs.name: --sa-radius-outer
knobs.label: Container radius
knobs.meaning: Card and dialog corners.

knobs.name: --sa-pills
knobs.label: Pill tags
knobs.meaning: Tags (badges, chips, the switch) are pills instead of following the radius.

knobs.name: --sa-outlines
knobs.label: Outlines
knobs.meaning: Filled parts (buttons, badges, chips, the switch track) also draw an outline.

knobs.name: --sa-relief
knobs.label: Relief
knobs.meaning: Raised adds a shadow under buttons; tactile also adds a bottom edge, a hover lift, a pressed state and recessed fields.

knobs.name: --sa-sheen
knobs.label: Sheen
knobs.meaning: Solid buttons get a lit surface: a gradient, a top highlight, a darker edge and a pressed shadow.

knobs.name: --sa-stroke
knobs.label: Stroke
knobs.meaning: Border width.

knobs.name: --sa-elevation
knobs.label: Elevation
knobs.meaning: Shadow strength: 0 flat, 1 soft, 2 or more floating.

knobs.name: --sa-density
knobs.label: Density
knobs.meaning: Spacing and control sizes, not type: 0.75 dense to 1.25 roomy.

knobs.name: --sa-type-scale
knobs.label: Type scale
knobs.meaning: Text sizes.

knobs.name: --sa-font-sans
knobs.label: Font
knobs.meaning: Body and control font.

knobs.name: --sa-font-heading
knobs.label: Heading font
knobs.meaning: Titles.

knobs.name: --sa-font-mono
knobs.label: Monospace font
knobs.meaning: Code.

knobs.name: --sa-kbd-font
knobs.label: Keyboard key font
knobs.meaning: Keyboard keys.

knobs.name: --sa-weight-control
knobs.label: Control weight
knobs.meaning: Buttons, tabs, menu items.

knobs.name: --sa-weight-heading
knobs.label: Heading weight
knobs.meaning: Titles.

knobs.name: --sa-leading-body
knobs.label: Line height
knobs.meaning: Line height of running text.

knobs.name: --sa-section-label-font
knobs.label: Font
knobs.meaning: Section labels: menu labels, sidebar group labels, and column heads when they take the section label style.

knobs.name: --sa-section-label-text
knobs.label: Size
knobs.meaning: Section label text size.

knobs.name: --sa-section-label-weight
knobs.label: Weight
knobs.meaning: Section label weight.

knobs.name: --sa-section-label-transform
knobs.label: Case
knobs.meaning: Section label case.

knobs.name: --sa-section-label-tracking
knobs.label: Tracking
knobs.meaning: Section label letter spacing.

knobs.name: --sa-footer-fill
knobs.label: Card footer band
knobs.meaning: Card footers sit on a tinted band.

knobs.name: --sa-footer-rule
knobs.label: Card footer rule
knobs.meaning: Card footers have a divider above them.

knobs.name: --sa-dialog-footer-fill
knobs.label: Dialog footer band
knobs.meaning: Dialog and sheet footers sit on a tinted band.

knobs.name: --sa-dialog-footer-rule
knobs.label: Dialog footer rule
knobs.meaning: Dialog and sheet footers have a divider above them.

knobs.name: --sa-column-head-label
knobs.label: Column heads as labels
knobs.meaning: Table column heads take the section label style.

knobs.name: --sa-column-head-fill
knobs.label: Column head band
knobs.meaning: Table column heads sit on a sunken band.

knobs.name: --sa-column-head-case
knobs.label: Column head case
knobs.meaning: Table column head case.

knobs.name: --sa-column-head-font
knobs.label: Column head font
knobs.meaning: Table column head font.

knobs.name: --sa-current-page-fill
knobs.label: Current page
knobs.meaning: The current page in pagination.

knobs.name: --sa-solid-destructive
knobs.label: Solid destructive
knobs.meaning: Destructive buttons are solid instead of a soft tint.

knobs.name: --sa-filled-secondary
knobs.label: Filled secondary
knobs.meaning: Secondary buttons have a sunken fill instead of a bordered surface.

knobs.name: --sa-link-decoration
knobs.label: Link buttons
knobs.meaning: Link buttons at rest.

knobs.name: --sa-press-offset
knobs.label: Press nudge
knobs.meaning: How far a button moves when pressed.

knobs.name: --sa-focus-width
knobs.label: Ring width
knobs.meaning: Focus ring width.

knobs.name: --sa-focus-offset
knobs.label: Ring offset
knobs.meaning: Gap between the control and the ring.

knobs.name: --sa-focus-color
knobs.label: Ring colour
knobs.meaning: Focus ring colour.
